observed_contract: all active children leave IDLE and progress independently
aggregate state precedence is READY, CONNECTING, IDLE, then TRANSIENT_FAILURE
only READY child pickers contribute their configured weight
the selected child delegates to its own picker
weighted selection is consumed by one RPC claim rather than by every racing endpoint task

implementation.runtime_tree: allocator-owned runtime nodes mirror the ServiceConfig tree and retain borrowed target names through State-owned config lifetime
implementation.path: each nested weighted child extends the consumed hierarchical endpoint prefix by one element
implementation.aggregate: leaf and parent connectivity are recomputed under the SharedChannel ownership lock
implementation.weighted_pick: one random sample covers the sum of READY child weights; unavailable children add no range
implementation.claim_stability: State caches the exact selected worker until that worker claims the queued job or becomes unavailable
implementation.pick_first: one child-local selected worker remains sticky while READY and with capacity
implementation.round_robin: child-local cursor advances only after the chosen worker claims the job
implementation.lifetime: cached pick-first pointers are cleared before Worker destruction and recursive node allocation is transactional
implementation.child_channels: physical worker Channels retain method/retry service config but skip the outer weighted_target selector

negative_boundary.unsupported_shared_leaves: reject with InvalidSharedOptions before workers start

native_cases: three real h2c servers become READY through independent endpoint owners
weight-1 target delegates through a nested weighted target to a two-endpoint round-robin leaf
weight-3 target delegates to a pick-first leaf
400 RPCs observe a bounded 1:3 parent distribution
the two low-weight child endpoints differ by at most one request
a weight-100 unavailable child receives zero picks while a weight-1 READY sibling completes every RPC
unsupported least-request, ring-hash, WRR, and outlier children fail initialization without leaks
recursive runtime construction passes every induced allocation failure
verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel weighted target' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC weighted target runtime boundary' -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel weighted target rejects' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='SharedChannel weighted target runtime construction' --summary all
remaining_gap: least-request, ring-hash, WRR, outlier children, resolver membership churn, and ordinary Channel execution remain before broad weighted_target support
